answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The anchor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the plume of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
